declarations.description:
A floating bar that appears while a form or a settings page has unsaved changes: "Unsaved changes", then Discard
and Save. Place it after the form, inside the same scroll container: it sticks to the bottom of that container and
floats over the content, taking no room in the layout. Leave some bottom padding on the form so the bar never
covers its last field.

The app owns the changes. Set `open` while the form differs from what was saved; the bar slides in, and slides away
when `open` is cleared. Save fires `save` and Discard fires `discard`; neither changes `open` itself. While the app
saves, set `saving`: the Save button shows a spinner, both buttons stop responding and the message reads "Saving…".
Set `invalid` while the changes cannot be saved: the indicator turns to the error colour and Save is disabled.

With `shortcut`, Ctrl+S (⌘S on a Mac) anywhere on the page fires `save` while the bar is open, instead of the
browser's "Save page". With `warn-on-leave`, the browser asks before the page is closed or reloaded while the bar is
open. The message is announced to screen readers as the bar shows and as saving starts. Hiding the bar takes its
buttons out of the Tab order, so after a save or a discard move focus back into the form.

Extra actions (a Preview button, a link to the change history) go in the default slot, before Discard. Where the bar
is 480px wide or less (a phone), the message takes the top row and the buttons share a full-width row below.
declarations.name: SaveBar

cssProperties.description: `sticky` follows the bottom of the scroll container; `fixed` pins the bar to the viewport.
cssProperties.name: --c2-save-bar--position

cssProperties.description: Space between the indicator, the message and the actions.
cssProperties.name: --c2-save-bar__container--gap

cssProperties.description: `100%` (with a `0` radius and inset) makes a full-width bar.
cssProperties.name: --c2-save-bar__container--width

cssProperties.description: `space-between` pushes the actions to the far edge of a wide bar.
cssProperties.name: --c2-save-bar__container--justify-content

cssProperties.description: How far the bar slides as it shows and hides.
cssProperties.name: --c2-save-bar__container--offset

cssProperties.description: The dot before the message; `0` hides it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-save-bar__indicator--size

cssProperties.description: Height of the Discard and Save buttons.
cssProperties.name: --c2-save-bar__button--height

slots.description: Further actions, shown before Discard: `c2-button`s, a `c2-link-button`.
slots.name: default

slots.description: Replaces the "Unsaved changes" text, for example to say what changed or what to fix; it is announced when slotted. "Saving…" still shows while `saving`.
slots.name: message

members.name: open
members.description: Shows the bar. Set it while there are unsaved changes and clear it once they are saved or discarded.

members.name: saving
members.description: The changes are being saved: Save shows a spinner, both buttons stop responding and the message reads "Saving…".

members.name: invalid
members.description: The changes cannot be saved as they are: Save is disabled and the indicator turns to the error colour.

members.name: shortcut
members.description: Ctrl+S (⌘S on a Mac) fires `save` while the bar is open, instead of the browser's "Save page".

members.name: warnOnLeave
members.description: Asks before the page is closed or reloaded while the bar is open.

members.name: saveLabel
members.description: The Save button's text. Empty uses the built-in "Save" in the page's language.

members.name: discardLabel
members.description: The Discard button's text. Empty uses the built-in "Discard" in the page's language.

members.name: wasOpen
members.description: Whether the bar was open at the last update: it slides only when that changes, never on the first render.

members.name: slottedMessage
members.description: The text of the slotted `message`, announced in place of the built-in "Unsaved changes".

members.name: guarding
members.description: Whether the `beforeunload` listener is attached: only while it can warn, so other pages keep the back/forward cache.

members.name: save
members.description: Fires `save`, as the Save button does, unless the bar is closed, saving or invalid.

members.name: discard
members.description: Fires `discard`, as the Discard button does, unless the bar is closed or saving.

members.name: guard
members.description: Attaches the `beforeunload` listener while `warn-on-leave` and `open` are both set, and only then.

members.name: slide
members.description:
Slides the bar up into place as it shows, and down as it hides, while it fades (a CSS transition). An animation
rather than a transition, so the closed bar rests in place: only while it moves does it reach below its spot.

events.name: save
events.description: The Save button was activated, or Ctrl+S / ⌘S was pressed with `shortcut`. Save the changes, then clear `open`. Does not bubble.

events.name: discard
events.description: The Discard button was activated. Restore the saved values, then clear `open`. Does not bubble.
